rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update
# The folders the compiler searches anyway are those of the prefix, flags # for them are left out of the output. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-silent-rules \ --with-system-libdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --with-system-includedir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include"
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
rm -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib/"*.la
# pkg-config is only available under the name with the system type in # front, as it was with the pkg-config package. ln -s pkgconf \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config"
